issue.title: Remove the retired review homes kind and daily-review theme phrase from Bob Mac Capture

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-dm.land in bob-cli-e2 note #2, item (3); triaged by the bob-cli-e2 land agent.

bob-cli-e2 (retire-review phase, bob-cli 511c7ad7) retired the homes `kind: "review"` and the PT13 theme suggestion `source: "review"` ("daily review suggests X"). Bob Mac Capture still carries both as dead code:
- Sources/CaptureCore/PomodoroHomes.swift: `CaptureAgendaHomesKind.review` plus its `"review"` decode and encode arms (about lines 179-203).
- Sources/CaptureCore/CaptureTaskThemePresentation.swift: the `case "review": return "daily review suggests ..."` arm (lines 24-25) and the doc comment on line 10, which still cites a `daily review suggests X` phrase that `format_task_theme_row` in bob-cli src/native/capture/output.rs no longer emits.

Remove them. An unknown "review" then decodes to `.other("review")` and renders the "no default here" fallback, which matches bob's current contract. A grep found no `.review` or `daily review` use in Tests/ or elsewhere in Sources/. Verify with the macOS CI build and tests.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved bob-cli-e2 plan explicitly scoped Bob Mac Capture out ("It decodes homes.kind and theme source tolerantly (unknown values become .other), so retiring review needs no Swift change"). Runtime behavior is already correct, so this is optional dead-copy cleanup in a separate repo with macOS-only verification, not epic work.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-dm.land flagged dead review copy in Bob Mac Capture on bob-cli-e2; the e2 plan scoped Mac Capture out, so the land agent filed it as separate optional cleanup.
